# SANA

> Physical-AI and applied-AI engineering firm. 50+ projects shipped. IEEE-published. Co-organizers of three IROS 2026 robotics challenges. Florida HQ, Seoul office.

Identity: SANA Company, legal name SANA IT Solutions LLC, at sanacompany.io. Applied-AI and robotics engineering. HQ Coconut Creek, Florida; office in Seoul. Led by Santiago Pravisani (CEO) and Esteban Fuhrmann (CTO).
